newsitem.title: UK: EU money would face special problems - UK's Blair.
newsitem.headline: EU money would face special problems - UK's Blair.

text.p: Britain's main opposition Labour party leader Tony Blair said on Friday a single currency area within the European Union would face problems not encountered by other areas of the world which use the same money.
But Blair said it was important for Britain to leave its options open on whether to join a single currency and to take an active part in negotiations on how it would work.

Interviewed on BBC radio, Blair said: "When you lose the exchange rate method of adjustment, if economies move out of sync with one another, there isn't the same ability for mobility of labour as there is in other single currency areas."
"There isn't really the possibility of large fiscal transfers to compensate, so there are all those questions, you have to bear those in mind," he added.
But Blair added: "The euro as a currency will affect us whether we are in it or out of it, so it is important that we remain in these negotiations."
